entries.sourcePath: Project/背单词/单词动词/行动_努力_坚持_责任.md
entries.body:
- 释义：逮捕，破产，破产的，女人的胸部，（石头或金属）半身像
- 例句：
  - They were busted for possession of cannabis：他们因藏有大麻被逮捕
  - It is taxpayers who will pay most of the bill for bailing out bust banks：纳税人将支付大部分的账单以解救面临倒闭的银行
  - Good posture also helps your bust look bigger：优美的姿势也能让你的胸部看起来更丰满
  - His friends busted him out of jail：朋友们帮他逃出了监狱（bust out：逃跑，越狱）
  - They bust up after five years together：他们在一起五年后分道扬镳了（bust up：夫妻或朋友分手，拆伙）
  - We had a huge bust-up and now we’re not talking：我们大吵了一通，现在不说话了（bust-up：争吵，吵嘴）
  - I’m not going to bust a gut trying to be on time when I know she’ll probably be late：我知道她很可能会晚来时，就不打算拚命按时赶到了（bust a gut：努力做某事）

entries.sourcePath: Project/背单词/单词名词/其他_杂项.md
entries.body:

  - There are hints that the problem is in fact more nuanced than that：有迹象显示这个问题事实上比那个更复杂
  - His views have always been more nuanced than either his enemies or his fans have been willing to admit：他的观点向来都比他的敌人或粉丝所愿意承认的更有差距
  - Better to take a more nuanced approach：最好采取一个更加不同的方法
  - They worry that he's too nuanced：他们担心他太吹毛求疵了
